music.credit: Laserpack Kevin MacLeod ft. DarkNES (incompetech.com). Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
music.use: Trimmed to the film length from its first downbeat and faded out; not time-stretched. Cut whooshes and mouse-click sounds are mixed in softly.
music.fallback: tools/media/music.py can synthesize an original score instead (`film.py --synth`).

fonts: Inter and Noto Sans JP (SIL OFL), rasterized only; no font binaries are redistributed
visuals: Native Gallery and Node Editor OpenGL backbuffers recorded through public Dear ImGui IO, with a large synchronized cursor; captions and transitions are original.
